first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making onboarding simplification the most direct, sustainable lever for qualified revenue. I will verify the prior onboarding and pricing records before committing, since aggressive competitor pricing makes the pricing alternative material.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified prior result improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting durable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is not selected because its verified retention harm makes it unsuitable for the primary objective despite competitor pressure.
